reason_for_correction: The request asks for the release and changes, not independent-source corroboration. One cited official release note can establish both. Multiple copied secondary pages are not stronger evidence.

new_requirement.cited_claim_patterns: release-version and changes must have valid inline citations; plain colon-ended labels are not factual assertions
new_requirement.cited_url_patterns: At least one cited official github.com/ollama/ollama/releases URL

production_fix: Preserve consecutive headings as one context label, do not merge separate sections just because headings have identical names, and send escaped section metadata beside each passage. No extra model calls or topic-specific instruction.

- A new feature allowing ten web searches per response [1].
- A version bump for MLX [1].
- A version bump for llama.cpp to b11232 [1].
